stories.title: Record weekly ship attacks in Strait of Hormuz as oil shipment recovery slows
stories.summary: Twelve vessels reported attacks between 5 October and 11 October, the highest weekly total since the US‑Israeli war with Iran began. The prior week recorded ten attacks, including six incidents on a single Sunday, and four attacks have been reported so far this week. Industry data suggests the rise in attacks has coincided with a slowdown in the recent recovery of oil shipments through the strait.
stories.why: The surge threatens safe navigation and could further disrupt global oil supplies.

stories.title: India’s forex reserves fall to $726.03 bn in week ended Oct 9
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India reported that foreign‑exchange reserves declined by $8.578 billion, to $726.027 billion, in the week ended 9 October. The fall followed a $12.952 billion decline in the previous week. The decrease was driven by lower foreign‑currency assets, reduced gold holdings, and drops in special drawing rights and the IMF reserve position.
stories.why: RBI action or currency-market developments can affect rupee volatility, hedging costs and foreign-exchange conditions for businesses and investors.

stories.title: India aims for $100 billion bilateral trade with Russia by 2030
stories.summary: Indian Ambassador to Russia Vinay Kumar said India is negotiating a free‑trade agreement with the Eurasian Economic Union to boost exports. He projected that total India‑Russia trade will reach about US$100 billion by 2030, up from roughly US$38 billion recorded in the first half of the current year. The government is working to diversify its export basket and improve market access in Russia.
stories.why: Trade developments can affect currencies, business costs, market access and the external balance of the economies involved.

stories.title: Seven crew missing after drone attack leaves tanker ablaze off Romania's coast
stories.summary: A search and rescue operation involving boats and helicopters is now continuing in rough seas, Romania's authorities say Seven of 12 crew members are missing after a drone attack left a chemical tanker ablaze off Romania's coast on Thursday morning, naval authorities say. Romanian President Nicușor Dan confirmed that the Wine Trader and another chemical tanker in the area, the Yara J, had both been struck by drones - the Yara J on Wednesday.
stories.why: This matters because it could affect economic conditions, trade, technology, public systems or international decisions.

stories.title: Houthi missile attack on Yemeni presidential palace kills five, minister says
stories.summary: Five people have been killed and 16 injured in a Houthi missile attack targeting the presidential palace in the port city of Aden in southern Yemen, which is the seat of the internationally-recognised government, officials say. Information Minister Moammar al-Eryani told the BBC that the prime minister and other ministers were unhurt when five ballistic missiles hit al-Maashiq Palace.
